method: bounded stochastic hill-climb over exact quantized Hex8 candidates; controlled identical seed pairs for categorical/terminal per profile x lane; sequential searched once per profile and reused across lanes because its objective is foreground-invariant; foreground lanes fixed by construction
foreground_target: corresponding 3400k-light fg role Oklab a/b, preserving each dark role current Oklab L

categorical.bounds: each shipped sRGB byte ±18, clipped to [0,255]
categorical.objective: hard release floors, then separation/clearance/contrast/corner evidence/movement

terminal.bounds: each shipped sRGB byte ±16, clipped to [0,255]
terminal.objective: hard release floors and semantic hue recognition, then separation/clearance/contrast/corner evidence/movement

sequential.bounds: each shipped anchor sRGB byte ±10, clipped to [0,255]
